messages.en: I feel a bit more at ease after our chat earlier. Thanks.
If you want to talk some more, just message me. I'm here for you.

senses.en_definition: Outstanding or impressive in ability, quality, or performance.

messages.en: All the reports are done. Just need to check them tomorrow before sending them in.
You're amazing! That's a lot of reports. How did you get them all done so quickly?

senses.en_definition: An exclamation used to greet someone, attract attention, or express surprise or annoyance.

messages.en: Hey, are you here yet? I'm outside, near the main entrance.
Yeah, but I'm at the entrance next to the supermarket. Hang on, I'm walking over.
That helicopter has landed on the school field.
Oh, no wonder it was so loud earlier. I'm just watching from home.
